headline: Today's top AI story: llama.cpp b11514 released
bullets: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
Anthropic launches OSS Scanner, which provides free, opt-in security audits for open-source projects by sending AI-generated reports without human review (Anthropic)
USV raised $900M, including a $500M early-stage fund, up from $275M in 2024, cuts its general partnership to four investors, and aims to lead more AI rounds (Bloomberg)
